summary: Expanded the vertical-AI software/data-integration node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. Palantir is retained only as the reference leader for defense/enterprise data-platform context. The underfollowed lane focuses on companies where the possible scarce input is not generic model access, but proprietary data engineering capacity, mission-specific government AI deployment, or regulated policy/compliance data embedded into enterprise workflows. Claims remain mostly hypothesis/inference at Layer 1B because revenue purity, customer concentration, contract durability, and AI-specific margin contribution still need filing-level verification.
